about: Mods and texture packs recommended for the MH4U PC port, installed by tools/mods.py install-from-catalog (the launcher's Mods screen, Catalog). Only metadata and the authors' own download links: nothing here is the game or its files. docs/MODS.md says how to suggest a mod and what each field means.

mods.name: Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate HD
mods.author: mhondeck and the MH classic HD Project
mods.description: The whole game remastered in HD: environments, armor, weapons, monsters, NPCs and the interface (building on MH4HDUI).
mods.details: HD v3.0 (about 11 GB) and its latest update roll-up (3.01-3.03), installed together as the author describes: the base pack, its UI folder removed, then the roll-up over it. Credits: Tywald, Aki, Grand Tickler and tbsp (earlier versions), xl3lackout (MH4HDUI), Monkbreh and PixelCover (MHGU HD textures), Kestis, Sisnax.
mods.region_note: The pack's USA build (title 0004000000126300), made with the v1.1 update that the port runs. Play in English: some menus in other languages aren't covered yet.
mods.license: No licence stated; shared freely by its author, who asks players to pass it on. Downloaded from the author's own links.
mods.note: A big download (about 12 GB, and as much again free while it unpacks). The author notes that the monsters' HD textures show only with Azahar's New 3DS mode off; the port's app turns it off by itself while custom textures are on.

mods.name: MH4HDUI
mods.author: xl3lackout
mods.description: The interface redrawn by hand at four times the resolution: the hunting HUD, icons and fonts. A small download, for a sharp interface without the full HD pack.
mods.details: A work in progress (the author's estimate: hunting HUD about 90%, icons 50%, fonts 65%, loading screens 20%). Only its UI folder goes into the texture folder, as its readme says.
mods.region_note: Made with MH4U; the author doesn't name a region. Text textures follow the game's language: play in English.
mods.license: CC0-1.0 (public domain); the author asks for credit.
mods.note: The HD pack already has an updated version of it: install one or the other.

mods.name: 100% crafting success
mods.author: anco (MH4U quality-of-life project)
mods.description: Every item combination succeeds: no more failed combinations, and no combo books needed for the odds.
mods.details: The first patch of anco's project to bring later games' quality-of-life changes to MH4U. A code patch (code.ips) that changes only the game's data, not its code.
mods.region_note: For MH4U USA (0004000000126300) with its v1.1 update. It changes only data, so the port's code library doesn't need building again.
mods.note: Azahar applies one code patch at a time, so only one code mod of the catalog can be on.

mods.name: Charge Blade: Fast Morph Guard Point
mods.author: JackUnderTheHood
mods.description: A Guard Point on the Charge Blade's Fast Morph Slash, also the directional one, keeping its animation, movement and follow-ups; red-shield phial bursts work.
mods.details: Tested by its author on Azahar (USA v1.1 runtime validation). A code patch that changes the game's code and adds new code after it (a "code cave").
mods.region_note: Its USA v1.1 build (0004000000126300), the update the port runs.
mods.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Downloading and installing it is allowed; ask the author before sharing it elsewhere.
mods.note: It changes the game's code and adds new code after it: build the code library again with it on (the launcher offers to); until then the game runs on Azahar's own CPU emulation. Only one code mod can be on at a time.

mods.name: Weapon Honing: Life rework (with Charge Blade Guard Points)
mods.author: JackUnderTheHood
mods.description: Weapon Honing: Life heals like MHW's Health Regen augment: 7.5% of the damage of each eligible hit, with a short green glow. Includes both Charge Blade Guard Point mods (Fast Morph and Charged Double Slash).
mods.details: Replaces Life's 18-second cooldown and 30% chance with a heal on every eligible hit (0.2-second shared cooldown, at least 1 HP). Tested by its author on Azahar and on a 3DS.
mods.region_note: Its USA v1.1 build (0004000000126300), the update the port runs.
mods.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Downloading and installing it is allowed; ask the author before sharing it elsewhere.
mods.note: It already has both Guard Point mods: don't turn the Fast Morph one on with it (only one code mod can be on anyway). It changes the game's code and adds new code after it: build the code library again with it on (the launcher offers to); until then the game runs on Azahar's own CPU emulation.
